decisions.reviewer: Codex GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra / independent scientific reviewer /root/requires_canonical_review
decisions.rationale: The exact replacement removes the ratio-equality proportionality test and supplies signed rational sums/differences plus solving a single multiplicative unknown. Both whole nominees fit the one-dimensional force balance and F=ma, including unknown mass/acceleration and inverse mass dependence; no spatial component algebra is imposed. The native elevator-up-but-slowing and same-net-pull carts bodies still require the independent Physics distinctions between velocity and acceleration, inertial mass and force, and coordinate convention. The new prerequisites supply arithmetic routines while leaving units and direction physically explained, rather than replacing the goal with a calculation.

goal.title: Grundgleichung der Mechanik anwenden
goal.description: Die lernende Person kann für einfache eindimensionale Bewegungen eines Körpers konstanter Masse in einem Inertialsystem die Beziehung $\sum F_\mathrm{ext}=m\cdot a$ mit einer gewählten Vorzeichenrichtung anwenden und Kräftegleichgewicht ($\sum F_\mathrm{ext}=0$) von beschleunigter Bewegung unterscheiden.
goal.descriptionEn: The learner can apply the relation $\sum F_\mathrm{ext}=m\cdot a$ using a chosen positive direction to simple one-dimensional motions of a constant-mass body in an inertial frame and distinguish force equilibrium ($\sum F_\mathrm{ext}=0$) from accelerated motion.
